description: Observatorio de Banda Ancha. Velocidades is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idena.navarra.es. Information provided by telecommunications operators for each urban sub-plot where they have effective coverage of wired broadband networks (FTTH/HFC) or fixed wireless broadband networks (excluding LTE/4G/5G networks): -Download speed offered on subscriber side (100Mbps, 300Mbps, 1000Mbps). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Broadband Observatory. Speeds" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Utility and governmental services, Dataset público con descarga disponible. The listing shows 2025-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
